event_records.description: The recruiter has already attempted to call both referees but has not yet received a return call from either.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.persona_brief:
You are Recruiter.
The recruiter has been trying to contact the two referees listed by Aoife Byrne. They have the referees' contact information and need to speak with both before the interview panel meets next Thursday.

referee_1.name: Referee 1
referee_1.persona_brief:
You are Referee 1.
Referee 1 is one of the referees listed by Aoife Byrne. They may or may not be aware of the recruiter's attempts to contact them. They have their own schedule and priorities.

referee_2.name: Referee 2
referee_2.persona_brief:
You are Referee 2.
Referee 2 is one of the referees listed by Aoife Byrne. They may or may not be aware of the recruiter's attempts to contact them. They have their own schedule and priorities.

resolution.question: Will both referees listed by shortlisted candidate Aoife Byrne return the recruiter's calls before the interview panel meets next Thursday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-08-20T09:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that both Referee 1 and Referee 2 have returned the recruiter's calls (i.e., each has had a conversation with the recruiter initiated by the referee returning a call). Otherwise resolve NO.
